newsitem.title: LEBANON: South Lebanon Palestinians in anti-Israel strike.
newsitem.headline: South Lebanon Palestinians in anti-Israel strike.

text.p: Palestinians in refugee camps in south Lebanon staged a strike on Thursday to protest against the killing of seven Palestinians by Israeli troops in the West Bank.
In Ain el-Hilweh, Lebanon's biggest camp with some 75,000 refugees near the southern port of Sidon, shops closed and armed pro-PLO militants burned tyres at entrances to the camp, witnesses said.
The strike was also observed in four other south Lebanon camps where Palestinian President Yasser Arafat enjoys wide support. Some 350,000 Palestinian refugees live in 12 camps across Lebanon.
On Wednesday, Israeli troops killed seven Palestinians and wounded hundreds in fierce clashes sparked by Israel's opening of a tunnel in Arab East Jerusalem near Islam's third-holiest site.
